SOURCE tools/decomp/standalone.py
SHA256 04e97c6496e2d60edb09245ecd78da62c1835e3c061c58c02f8fa0f6d7ff750f

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Link-only residual without originals.ld, hooks or original data redirects.
0003: 
0004:     python3 tools/decomp/standalone.py [--tu T.cpp] [--library /pinned/library.so]
0005: 
0006: Builds ordinary GCC 4.4 objects. A failed link is the expected remaining work;
0007: no unresolved symbol is replaced by a stub or an original ELF address.
0008: Even a closed link-only slice is not evidence of a runnable standalone game.
0009: """
0010: import argparse
0011: import hashlib
0012: import json
0013: from pathlib import Path
0014: import subprocess
0015: 
0016: import elfdb
0017: import elfimage
0018: import hybrid
0019: import publication
0020: import toolchain
0021: 
0022: 
0023: def classify(names, db, image):
0024:     game = {t["id"] for t in db["tus"] if t["kind"] == "game"}
0025:     functions = {n for f in db["functions"].values() if f["tu"] in game for n in f["names"]}
0026:     files = {t["name"] for t in db["tus"] if t["kind"] == "game"}
0027:     data = {g["name"] for g in db["globals"] if g.get("file") in files}
0028:     external = {s.name.split("@")[0] for s in image.dynsyms if not s.defined}
0029:     rows = {key: [] for key in ("game_functions", "game_data", "rtti", "vtables", "library_imports", "unknown")}
0030:     for name in sorted(names):
0031:         kind = ("game_functions" if name in functions else "game_data" if name in data else
0032:                 "rtti" if name.startswith(("_ZTI", "_ZTS")) else "vtables" if name.startswith(("_ZTV", "_ZTT")) else
0033:                 "library_imports" if name in external else "unknown")
0034:         rows[kind].append(name)
0035:     return rows
0036: 
0037: 
0038: def inspect(tus=(), libraries=(), out=None):
0039:     root = elfdb.ROOT
0040:     out = out or root / "build-decomp/standalone"
0041:     out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0042:     db = elfdb.load_db()
0043:     image = elfimage.load(elfdb.default_elf())
0044:     if image.sha256 != elfimage.ORIGINAL_SHA256:
0045:         raise RuntimeError("original ELF identity changed")
0046:     sources = sorted((root / "decomp/src").rglob("*.cpp"))
0047:     if tus:
0048:         unknown = set(tus) - {p.name for p in sources}
0049:         if unknown:
0050:             raise ValueError("no source for " + ", ".join(sorted(unknown)))
0051:         sources = [p for p in sources if p.name in tus]
0052:     if not sources:
0053:         raise ValueError("no source slice")
0054:     libraries = [Path(p).resolve(strict=True) for p in libraries]
0055:     versions = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in libraries}
0056:     def compile_unit(source):
0057:         # Ordinary objects retain source data and static initialization.
0058:         path = out / (source.name + ".o")
0059:         toolchain.compile_source(source, path, quiet=True, cache=False)
0060:         return path
0061:     with publication.tree_lock():
0062:         snapshot = publication.tree_state(root)
0063:         objects = toolchain.parallel_map(compile_unit, sources)
0064:         defined, undefined, initializers, locals_ = set(), set(), set(), []
0065:         for path in objects:
0066:             obj = elfimage.load_object(path)
0067:             defined |= hybrid.defined_symbols(path)
0068:             undefined |= hybrid.undefined_symbols(path)
0069:             initializers |= {s.name for s in obj.symbols if s.defined and s.name.startswith(("_GLOBAL__I_", "_GLOBAL__sub_I"))}
0070:             locals_ += [{"object": path.name, "symbol": s.name, "size": s.size} for s in obj.symbols
0071:                         if s.defined and s.bind == elfimage.STB_LOCAL and s.type == elfimage.STT_OBJECT]
0072:         unresolved = undefined - defined
0073:         output = out / "link-only.elf"
0074:         output.unlink(missing_ok=True)  # never leave a previous success next to a failed probe
0075:         command = ["ld", "-nostdlib", "-e", "0", "--build-id=none", "-o", str(output),
0076:                    *map(str, objects), *map(str, libraries)]
0077:         result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
0078:         if snapshot != publication.tree_state(root):
0079:             raise RuntimeError("source/header tree changed during link probe")
0080:     report = {"schema": 1, "original_elf_sha256": image.sha256,
0081:               "sources_sha256": {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources},
0082:               "libraries_sha256": versions, "command": command, "link_exit": result.returncode,
0083:               "link_closed": result.returncode == 0, "standalone_game_verified": False,
0084:               "residual_before_libraries": classify(unresolved, db, image),
0085:               "static_initializers": sorted(initializers), "local_static_data": locals_,
0086:               "diagnostics": result.stderr, "no_original_resolution": True,
0087:               "limitation": "link-only probe, entrypoint 0; no process execution or behavioral parity inferred"}
0088:     (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0089:     return report
0090: 
0091: 
0092: def main():
0093:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0094:     parser.add_argument("--tu", action="append", default=[])
0095:     parser.add_argument("--library", action="append", default=[])
0096:     parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path)
0097:     args = parser.parse_args()
0098:     report = inspect(args.tu, args.library, args.out)
0099:     print(json.dumps({"link_exit": report["link_exit"], "link_closed": report["link_closed"],
0100:                       "standalone_game_verified": False,
0101:                       "residual": {k: len(v) for k, v in report["residual_before_libraries"].items()}}, indent=1))
0102:     # A nonzero link is a reported residual, not a failed inspection command.
0103: 
0104: 
0105: if __name__ == "__main__":
0106:     main()
